verdict.rationale: Missions let users work with Droid to define features, milestones, and success criteria before any code is written, which covers structured scoping. Integrations with Jira, Linear, Slack, and Notion could bring in feedback sources, though the documented Linear/Jira flows have Droid implement assigned issues rather than create them. Turning user feedback into structured tasks would need to be assembled by hand from these general capabilities. missing for 10: a documented workflow that ingests user feedback submissions, automatic creation of structured tickets/tasks with proposed scope from feedback, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
